name: Daily Open Strategy (DOS): fade previous candle body > threshold
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
entry_long: Long when the previous candle is bearish with body (open-close) > PrevRange (0.01 price units); short when previous is bullish with body > PrevRange.
entry_short: Previous candle bullish with body > PrevRange -> short.
exit: Take profit 200 pips, stop loss 1000 pips.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited source; verify execution timing (signal bar vs next open) before implementation.
